title: Shelter Island
cn: 第 5 集 · 避风港岛
novel:
Stella's sister [[canceled|cancel]] her wedding at the last minute. Ted and Stella [[seized|seize]] the [[opportunity|opportunity]] and decided to take the [[venue|venue]] for themselves. They would get married that weekend on Shelter Island.

Everything moved fast. Ted [[invited|invite]] Robin, which [[annoyed|annoy]] Stella. "Why did you invite your ex?" she asked. Ted [[hesitated|hesitate]]. "She's my friend."

Robin [[returned|return]] from Japan just in time. She was jet-lagged but [[determined|determined]] to support Ted. Barney drove her to the island, and the car ride was [[awkward|awkward]].

At the [[venue|venue]], Ted felt a [[gnawing|gnaw]] doubt. He barely knew Stella's friends. Stella barely knew his. The wedding felt [[rushed|rushed]].

Stella's ex, Tony, [[showed up|show up]] [[unexpectedly|unexpectedly]]. He begged Stella to come back. Stella was [[torn|torn]]. She looked at Ted, then at Tony. The [[tension|tension]] was [[unbearable|unbearable]].

"I'm sorry, Ted," Stella [[whispered|whisper]]. She walked toward Tony. Ted stood alone at the [[altar|altar]], his heart [[shattered|shatter]].

Robin found Ted sitting outside in the cold. She sat beside him and said nothing. Sometimes, [[silence|silence]] was the only [[comfort|comfort]] she could offer.

"She chose him," Ted said [[bitterly|bitterly]].

"I know," Robin said softly.

cancel.en: to decide that something will not happen

venue.en: the place where an event happens

invite.en: to ask someone to come to an event

show up.en: to arrive where you are expected

altar.en: the place where a wedding happens

comfort.en: a feeling of being less sad

bitterly.en: in a way that shows deep sadness
